title: Refresh marketing copy + update flavors lineup

requirements.summary: Replace explicit “Indian Nepali youth/youths” mentions with inclusive “youths missing the taste of home” phrasing while keeping Kolkata homemade positioning across marketing copy and SEO.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section text no longer contains “Indian Nepali” wording (e.g., update the paragraph in frontend/src/sections/HomeHeroSection.tsx).
Our Story section highlights no longer contain “Serving Indian Nepali youth everywhere” (e.g., update the copy in frontend/src/sections/OurStorySection.tsx).
SEO meta description in frontend/index.html no longer contains “Indian Nepali youths” and instead describes the brand for youths missing the taste of home.
A case-insensitive search in the frontend codebase for “Indian Nepali” returns zero occurrences in user-facing text.

file_operations.description: Update the hero paragraph marketing copy to remove “Indian Nepali youths” and replace it with inclusive phrasing aimed at youths missing the taste of home, while retaining the homemade-in-Kolkata positioning.

Update the “For Our Community” highlight copy to remove “Serving Indian Nepali youth everywhere” and replace with inclusive “youths missing the taste of home” phrasing (or equivalent), keeping the brand/community tone.

Update footer marketing copy to remove “Indian Nepali youths” wording and replace with inclusive phrasing aligned with “youths missing the taste of home,” while still referencing Kolkata/homemade roots.
Revise the meta description to remove “Indian Nepali youths” and describe the brand as homemade pickles from Kolkata for youths missing the taste of home (or equivalent).

requirements.summary: Refresh the “Our Flavors” grid to show exactly the five requested flavor names in English UI context.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/sections/ProductsSection.tsx product data is updated so the rendered product cards show exactly the 5 requested flavor names.
The previous flavors (e.g., Nimbu Achar, Mirchi ka Achar, Mixed Veg Achar, Gajar ka Achar, Lahsun ka Achar) are no longer shown in the Products/Flavors grid.
The Products section renders without layout issues on mobile and desktop after the flavor update.

file_operations.description: Update the local products array so the rendered ProductCard grid shows exactly these 5 flavor names (spelled as requested): “Dalle ko achar”, “aam ko achar”, “mula ko achar”, “bhaisi ko achar”, “chicken ko achar”. Remove the previous flavors from the array, and adjust/keep English descriptions and spice levels as needed to maintain clean card/layout rendering across breakpoints.
